crwv.provider: Stock Analysis / S&P Global Market Intelligence

metrics.status: Historical completed-session statistics, not a forecast
metrics.dollarVolumeBasis: 20-session mean close times volume proxy; not actual traded dollars

crwv.note: Analytical snapshot from 21 completed daily observations, October 28–November 25. History was reopened to replace earlier intraday cached rows with completed-session values. No licensed live feed is connected; recheck your broker quote, spread and liquidity before sizing.

levels.rationale: The review low is the lowest observed low of the latest five sessions. The recovery reference is the November 23 close, before the November 24 selloff. A close back above it would recover that reference, but would not prove fair value or a durable trend. A fresh break below the review low calls for reassessing planned downside rather than automatically averaging down.
